claim: Treasury bills are recorded against each client's own account at a custodian ("Held in your name", "Your bills, your name")
Client money lands in a collection account kept apart from Finvest's own money
Finvest's records are checked against mobile money, bank and custodian statements every day, and a second person signs off
Interest is earned every day and shown daily, after tax
where: Home, How it works, Help, About ("Daily, interest shown in the app")

claim: A treasury bill held to maturity pays the amount shown when the client invests
Finvest does not lend client money out
Personal data is handled under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019, is used only to check identity and run the account, and is never sold

Support hours (chat in the app every day, 8am to 8pm; phone Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm), reply within one working day, complaints acknowledged within one working day and resolved within 10 working days
